      public void setManagerAccess(boolean isManager)

    • switchToManager

      private void switchToManager(javafx.event.ActionEvent event) throws IOException
      Changes the current view of the application from Cashier to Manager by reading manager.fxml. This is done on every call.
      Parameters:
      event - Unused button event.
      Throws:
      IOException - manager.fxml is malformed or missing from resources/.

    • onCheckout

      private void onCheckout(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Sends the currently selected order to the database, then removes it from the internal order entries list. Creates an alert if the selected order cannot be found or if the order has no items. Creates a confirmation popup on success. Used as an action for the checkout button.
      Parameters:
      event - Unused button event.

    • showToppingsPopup

      private void showToppingsPopup()
      Constructs a popup for the employee to select toppings for the current drink to be added. This popup is populated with a cached set of toppings from the database. showSugarPopup() is called when the confirm button is clicked.

    • showSugarPopup

      private void showSugarPopup(Set<Topping> chosenToppings)
      Constructs a popup for the employee to select the sugar level for the current drink to be added. showIcePopup() is called when the confirm button is clicked.
      Parameters:
      chosenToppings - the toppings selected for the current drink

    • showIcePopup

      private void showIcePopup(Set<Topping> chosenToppings)
      Constructs a popup for the employee to select the ice level for the current drink to be added. Creates and appends a new order item to the order's entries when Confirm is clicked.
      Parameters:
      chosenToppings - the toppings selected for the current drink
